changelog: Version metadata fix: the internal version constant now matches the published version again, so CS3M no longer reports a permanent pending update after installing the latest build.
Settings rows are swapped for the new app: the CS3 Manager entry sits in the Compose settings list of CloudStream 4.8.0+, and the legacy injected row is only used where it still exists.
Settings section hiding reports the truth on the Compose settings host: the option is marked as managed by CloudStream instead of silently doing nothing.
Host settings detection accepts both UI generations (SettingsFragment and SettingsFragment2).
New CloudStream home row supported: the host clock row can be hidden and picked in the Live Home editor.
